audit.whatIsWrong: Rows 4-5, first item and 2+ items are credited to Aurora/Skill while the whys on the same page say the opposite ('my bullying peak', 'snaps me back ahead', 'I keep out-ranging and chunking her').
audit.why: Aurora is mana-hungry and squishy; Karma's Inner Flame into RQ rotation out-tempos her at 4-5, and a Liandry's/Malignance spike beats her single-item poke. The packet chart agrees.
audit.corrected: Levels 4-5, first item and 2+ items are Karma's; level 6 stays even and levels 2-3 stay Aurora's.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why is template text that never names the level-6 window.
audit.why: Mantra is available at level 1, so Karma gains nothing at 6, while Between Worlds (140/120/100s) gives Aurora a leap, a slowing zone and a cross-zone teleport that sets up her burst.
audit.corrected: Level 6 named: Between Worlds sets her all-in and Across the Veil answers the tether.

audit.whatIsWrong: Neither layer states the decisive interaction: Across the Veil grants invisibility, and Focused Resolve reveals its target.
audit.why: Karma's W deals damage and reveals; only distance or line of sight breaks the tether, so a revealed Aurora cannot vanish out of the root — she has to physically leave range.
audit.corrected: Focused Resolve reveals her out of the spirit realm; root her as she lands rather than throwing the tether while Across the Veil (20s at rank 3) is up.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds line despite Spirit Abjuration healing her off every spell and attack.
audit.why: Her passive sustain is what survives Karma's chip in extended poke wars.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal added to the itemization line.

edits.before: Level 1 is mine because Mantra is usable from the start — I open RQ Soulflare for a delayed damage zone and slow that chips her off the wave before her poke pattern is even set up, and almost no laner can match that first-blood threat. Through 2-3 it tightens into a genuine skill matchup: she pokes back at range and her blink lets her dodge my Focused Resolve W, so I don't throw the tether unless her dash is down or she'll just step out and break the root. I keep last-hitting behind Inspire's shield and refund Mantra off every hit with Gathering Fire.
edits.after: Level 1 is yours because Mantra is usable from the start — open RQ Soulflare for a delayed damage zone and slow that chips her off the wave before her poke pattern is set up, and almost no laner can match that first-blood threat. Through 2-3 she takes over: she pokes back at range and Across the Veil (20s at rank 3) leaves your Focused Resolve behind, so don't throw the tether while it is up — she steps out and the root never lands. Last-hit behind Inspire's shield and refund Mantra off every hit with Gathering Fire.

edits.before: Levels 4-5 are my bullying peak — Inner Flame Q into RQ Soulflare rotations push her off the wave and let me tax plates behind Inspire's speed while she's mana-starved. Then 6 is a real dip for me, not a spike: my Mantra is only the re-empowerment I already had at level 1, while her R lets her set up a burst all-in and her blink answers my W tether, so her level-6 window genuinely beats mine. I respect that one window — don't shove face-first when her R is up and her blink is off cooldown.
edits.after: Levels 4-5 are your bullying peak — Inner Flame Q into RQ Soulflare rotations push her off the wave and let you tax plates behind Inspire's speed while she is mana-starved. edits.before: First item snaps me back: a Liandry's or Malignance spike sharpens my RQ Soulflare burst and Inspire shield value, and I'm favoured poking an Aurora who's stuck once her blink is down off the wave again. Into 2+ items I stay relevant because she's a squishy skirmish-mage I can keep out-ranging and chunking with Inner Flame Q before she lands her combo — I don't have to win a flat scaling race, just keep her off creeps and shield my carries. I convert the early-to-first-item lead and roam, because my utility wins fights even if her burst spikes harder in a clean 1v1.
